frame: X rearward along the bus, Y lateral (doors at Y>0), Z up; metres; origin front-bottom

T.label: Temperature
T.display_volume_rule: P2-P98 of CFD values over a volume-balanced sample of the cabin air (one cell per 8 cm voxel), clamped

speed.label: Air speed
speed.display_rule: 0 to CFD Interior P85, clamped (supply and leak jets saturate)
speed.display_volume_rule: 0 to P95 of CFD values over a volume-balanced sample of the cabin air (one cell per 8 cm voxel), clamped

slice_method.value: nearest exported Interior cell centre (no interpolation)
slice_method.no_data: nearest exported sample is a boundary face, or > 0.15 m away

reference_method: plane positions are ESTIMATED by matching render colours (inverted via each render's own colour bar) to the export; see REFERENCE_IMAGE_CHECK.md
geometry_note: boundary face centres from the CFD export, decimated; not a mesh

display_mesh.dtype: per patch: int16x3 vertices (bbox-quantised) then uint16x3 triangles
display_mesh.method: real boundary face centres thinned to one per voxel, PCA normals, per-axis Delaunay with long-edge removal
display_mesh.use: display only; not the solver mesh or CAD; never used for computation
